article_scope.purpose: compare fresh FEAST reference-rank simulations with retained external simulator artifacts across twelve spatial-transcriptomics datasets
article_scope.metric_rule: atomic metrics with exact gene and named-spot joins; ordered reference-derived Moran panel; no composite score

inputs.source: twelve locally materialized publication input H5ADs
48 frozen SRTsim, Splatter, Splatter_Simple, and scCube artifacts
inputs.policy: retain byte identity; recompute only the declared atomic metrics

observed_target_covariates: reference_rank uses the reference expression and coordinates; no separate biological target is observed

rng.article_gate: three fixed-seed scoped replays produced identical hashes
rng.scope_limit: the gate does not authorize a blanket unseeded or all-mode determinism claim

solver.success_gate: 12 readable finite H5ADs with exact manifest-bound spot/gene identity

fallback_policy.simulation_failure: fatal; do not replace a dataset
fallback_policy.missing_metric_support: report exact missingness; never substitute identifiers
fallback_policy.blocked_assignment: not used by this candidate; no general blocked-versus-global stability claim is made

evidence_binding.artifact_binding: large outputs are bound transitively by the simulation manifest

claim_limits: the historical composite score is prohibited
the historical OT-spatial arm is not part of this clean candidate
gene-variance Wasserstein worsened and must remain visible
fresh exact-global execution does not prove article-scale blocked-assignment stability
decision_required: authorize or narrow the simulator-quality claim after reviewing every atomic delta
reconcile the twelve-dataset scope and metric language with the manuscript and captions
